schema: CREATE TABLE Patients (patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE Tests (test_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INTEGER, score INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES Patients(patient_id));
correct_query: SELECT p.patient_id FROM Patients p JOIN Tests t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id ORDER BY t.score DESC LIMIT 1;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Redundant DISTINCT added to a query with ORDER BY and LIMIT 1 which alters sorted collapse results in SQLite
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM Patients p JOIN Tests t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id ORDER BY t.score DESC LIMIT 1;
